reviewed_by: the PI (name withheld for double-blind review)
derivation: pipeline_release stage s03_derive_targets, run against the discovery-run expA_logit_lens.json + expB_dla.json for det_4x4_error (n=59 discovery cases). Same algorithm used to produce Llama's targets.json.

preregistration_notes.patching_scope: s07 patching arm is MLP-only for this held-out round (habit_layers + check_layer + control_layers). L77-attn (self_attn.o_proj) is intentionally NOT patched -- the current pipeline_release s07_patching.py has no code path for attention-type sites, and adding one days before a one-shot run was judged too risky.
preregistration_notes.L77_attn_handling: L77 coverage instead comes from the existing s05 --with-heads attention ablation re-test (no new code required).
preregistration_notes.L77_attn_discovery_evidence: In the original discovery sign-matched patch run (det_4x4_error, n=44), L77_attn had a 0/44 (0.00%) fix rate with mean delta_ld=+0.033 -- statistically indistinguishable from the null controls (L30_mlp mean delta=+0.001, L50_mlp mean delta=-0.023), despite being pre-registered as predicted-corrective. This was a null/failed causal result, not a positive finding.
preregistration_notes.L77_attn_held_out_prediction: Pre-registered prediction: the s05 attention ablation re-test at L77 fails again on held-out data (no significant sign-flip recovery), consistent with the discovery null result.
